title: macOS named-source-root evaluator control compares /tmp and /private/tmp spellings
outcome: The named-source-root evaluator regression checks actual directory identity on macOS filesystem aliases while preserving the proof that an evaluator runs in the intended named root. Equivalent /tmp and /private/tmp spellings do not fail the control; a different root still does.
acceptance: A deterministic macOS alias witness reproduces the current named-source-root evaluator assertion mismatch without changing product dispatch or source-root authority.
The control passes for filesystem aliases of the same directory and retains a negative witness for a genuinely different evaluator directory; relevant focused checks pass on the final source.
